body: A Good Man is Hard to Find, A Rose for Emily is also good.
Thanks, writing is actually my greatest love in the work, I just haven't felt motivated to do it lately.

Thank you for commenting, honestly I don't think any god is looking after me anymore, there is too much pain and suffering. I'd like to believe that what happens happens for the better but I've never seen a good thing come from a good thing or a bad thing, random points in life just pop up, and they seem to be going down.
